analytics.name: Analytic 1685
analytics.guidance: For Android, detect Ptrace System Calls by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Host Status via Android Enterprise DPC [DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported]; Network Traffic Flow via Android Enterprise Network Logging / Enterprise VPN [DevicePolicyManager.retrieveNetworkLogs(): DnsEvent / ConnectEvent; VPN flow metadata]; Process Access via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: process in $TargetProcessList$ shows unexpected behavior change (new network destinations, new permission accesses) within $InjectionWindow$ of root status change — behavioral delta in target process post-injection is the anomaly indicator]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.

tuning.description: High-value processes that would be injection targets: media server, browser, system apps.
Per-device network destination baseline. Derive by measurement.

log_sources.name: android:DevicePolicyManager
log_sources.channel: DevicePolicyManager policy/compliance/security-state queries and SecurityLog events where supported

log_sources.name: mobile:DynamicAnalysis
log_sources.channel: Dynamic API/runtime trace: process in $TargetProcessList$ shows unexpected behavior change (new network destinations, new permission accesses) within $InjectionWindow$ of root status change — behavioral delta in target process post-injection is the anomaly indicator

analytics.name: Analytic 1686
analytics.guidance: For iOS, detect Ptrace System Calls by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate Host Status via Apple MDM [DeviceInformation / SecurityInfo / ProfileList / restrictions and compliance queries]; Network Traffic Flow via Apple Network Extension / Enterprise VPN [NEFilterFlow / per-app VPN / secure-web-gateway flow metadata]; Process Access via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: kernel log at level=fault referencing task_for_pid, mach_vm_write, or get-task-allow outside developer build on SUPERVISED device — Apple Unified Log kernel subsystem records these violations at fault level; supervised MDM with Unified Log ]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
